_comment: STUDYRIA BrainLab practice-set approvals — PUBLIC MIRROR. Why this exists: site_config has no public SELECT policy in production (owner hasn't run the one-time read-policy SQL), so anonymous students cannot read approvals from the database. This file is served statically (readable by everyone) and is synced from site_config by the agent (Solene) whenever the owner approves/revoke a subject in Admin → Test Engine. The engine prefers site_config when it returns rows (e.g. after the SQL is run); this mirror is the anon fallback. Fail-closed: a subject absent here = locked for students.

Biology.note: Owner-approved in Admin → Test Engine. Covers batch-1 (91) and batch-2 (60) Biology practice questions.

Chemistry.note: Owner-approved in Admin → Test Engine. Covers batch-1 (58) and batch-2 (40) Chemistry practice questions.

Physics.note: Owner-approved in Admin → Test Engine. Covers batch-1 (68) and batch-2 (40) Physics practice questions.
